description:
You are a Fish and Game Warden coordinating a missing-person search at Middlesex Fells Reservation, MA. A hiker has been reported overdue. You must build a complete GPS data package in Garmin BaseCamp for deploying two search teams.

The BaseCamp library already contains the fells_loop terrain reference data (86 waypoints covering the reservation).

Create the following 6 new waypoints in My Collection with the exact names, coordinates (decimal degrees), symbols, and comments shown:

1. Name: LKP - HAWTHORN RD  |  Lat: 42.4405  Lon: -71.1035  |  Symbol: Flag, Blue  |  Comment: Last Known Position - Found cell ping 2024-11-15 14:30. Do NOT disturb site.
2. Name: CP-ALPHA  |  Lat: 42.4440  Lon: -71.1120  |  Symbol: Flag, Red  |  Comment: Search Sector Alpha HQ. Team leader: Brown. Priority: High.
3. Name: CP-BRAVO  |  Lat: 42.4455  Lon: -71.0960  |  Symbol: Flag, Green  |  Comment: Search Sector Bravo HQ. Team leader: Davis. Covers N quadrant.
4. Name: ICS COMMAND POST  |  Lat: 42.4320  Lon: -71.1250  |  Symbol: Building  |  Comment: ICS HQ. Bellevue Pond Parking. Contact: Capt. Lee 617-555-0142
5. Name: HELICOPTER LZ NORTH  |  Lat: 42.4530  Lon: -71.1100  |  Symbol: Airport  |  Comment: LZ NORTH. Cleared 40x40m. Approach from S. No obstacles.
6. Name: MEDICAL STAGING  |  Lat: 42.4335  Lon: -71.1230  |  Symbol: Medical Facility  |  Comment: EMS staging. 2 AMBs on standby. Contact: Medic-1 617-555-0199

Create these 2 routes, with waypoints added in the exact order listed:

Route 1 — Name: ALPHA SEARCH ROUTE  |  Waypoints in order: ICS COMMAND POST, LKP - HAWTHORN RD, CP-ALPHA, CP-BRAVO, ICS COMMAND POST
Route 2 — Name: BRAVO SEARCH ROUTE  |  Waypoints in order: ICS COMMAND POST, MEDICAL STAGING, LKP - HAWTHORN RD, HELICOPTER LZ NORTH, CP-BRAVO, ICS COMMAND POST

When done, export the entire My Collection as a GPX file and save it to C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\SAR_Middlesex_Fells_2024.gpx
